youtube.title: The Weapons That Bowed to Rama | Ramayana Ep 6
youtube.description:
Divine weapons stood before Rama with palms joined and said: we serve you. ✨

The morning after Tataka, Vishvamitra smiled and gave young Rama all his weapons: the discus of Dharma, the discus of Time, the Vajra thunderbolt, the Brahma weapon, weapons of fire and wind, even one that brings sleep. Facing east, the sage gave him their mantras, rare even for the gods. As he chanted, the weapons stood before Rama, palms joined, and said they would serve him. Rama touched them and told them to dwell in his mind. Then he asked for one more thing: how to call them back. So the sage taught him the recall, and those powers bowed too, like embers, like smoke, like the sun and the moon. "Go now," Rama told them. "Come to my mind when I need you." Ahead lay Siddhashrama, where, the sage said, the rakshasas come.

📜 On screen (Valmiki Ramayana 1.28.2, vulgate):
"Gṛhītāstro'smi bhagavan durādharṣaḥ surair api, astrāṇāṃ tv aham icchāmi saṃhārān munipuṅgava"
(I have received the weapons, lord, and am unassailable even by the gods. Now, best of sages, I wish to learn their withdrawal.)
